server.note: Masculine: der Server. 'Add Server' = 'Server hinzufügen', 'Remove Server' = 'Server entfernen'.

tab.note: Existing strings are inconsistent between 'Tab' and 'Registerkarte'; majority and shorter form is 'Tab' (masculine: der Tab). 'New Tab' = 'Neuer Tab', 'Close Tab' = 'Tab schließen'.

view.note: Existing 'View limit reached' = 'Anzeigelimit erreicht'; use 'Ansicht' for the open-page sense and 'Anzeigelimit' for the limit setting.

popout window.note: Existing strings keep 'Popout' English ('Popout Menu', 'Call Widget Popout'); attach German 'Fenster' when the window itself is meant.

system tray.note: Existing rendering; note that Windows itself calls this area 'Infobereich' — keep 'Systemablage' for consistency with current strings.

notification area.note: Majority existing rendering; one string uses 'Nachrichtenbereich' (inconsistent, avoid).

minimize to tray.note: Existing dialog title: 'In Ablage minimieren'. Keep 'Ablage' consistent with 'Systemablage'.

Dock.note: macOS platform term, kept as 'Dock' in German macOS ('das Dock-Symbol').

taskbar.note: Windows platform term; taskbar icon = Taskleisten-Symbol (existing rendering).

badge.note: Existing strings mostly use 'rote Markierung' for the unread badge (one uses 'Abzeichen' — avoid). Unread badge = 'Markierung für ungelesene Nachrichten'.

bounce.note: Existing rendering: 'Lass das Dock-Symbol hüpfen'; formal register would be 'Dock-Symbol hüpfen lassen'.

start app on login.note: Existing: 'Starte Anwendung bei der Anmeldung'; 'Launch app minimized' = 'App minimiert starten'. App/Anwendung both occur; keep one per surface.

check for updates.note: Existing menu item: 'Prüfe auf Aktualisierungen'; settings: 'Automatisch auf Aktualisierungen prüfen'.

downloads.note: Kept English per Weblate glossary ('Download'); 'Download Location' = 'Speicherort für Downloads'.

certificate.note: Per Weblate glossary; certificate error = Zertifikatsfehler.

authentication secret.note: Consistent existing rendering in the pre-auth flow.

hardware acceleration.note: Existing string has unjoined 'GPU Hardware Beschleunigung'; correct German is 'GPU-Hardwarebeschleunigung' (community rules require compounding).

zoom.note: 'Zoom In' = Vergrößern, 'Zoom Out' = Verkleinern, 'Actual Size' = 'Tatsächliche Größe' (existing renderings).

full screen.note: Per Weblate glossary; full screen mode = Vollbildmodus, 'Toggle Full Screen' = 'Vollbild umschalten'.

clear data.note: 'Clear All Data' = 'Alle Daten löschen'; 'Clear Cache and Reload' = 'Cache leeren und neu laden' (clear = leeren for caches, per Weblate glossary).
